entities.name: Sofie Podlipská
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sofie Podlipská, née Rottová was a Czech writer and the sister of Karolina Světlá. Sofie Podlipská mostly wrote historical novels, juvenile works, and feminist literature. She also had an interest in Theosophy and helped found the "American Ladies' Club." The name had no geographical meaning instead the word "American" was to designate it, as modern and for progress. Her work emphasized motherhood and morality.

Her work emphasized motherhood and morality.
